title: PartnerNetworkRecordConnection - Data API
description: Represents a record shared between Salesforce organizations using Salesforce to Salesforce.

ConnectionId.description: ID of the connection a record is shared with.

EndDate.description: Date that sharing of the record was stopped.

ParentRecordId.description: ID of the parent record of the shared record.

PartnerRecordId.description: ID of the shared record in the connection's organization.

RelatedRecords.description: A comma-separated list of API names for child records to be shared with a parent record.

SendClosedTasks.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
SendClosedTasks.description: Forwards closed tasks related to the shared record.

SendEmails.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
SendEmails.description: Sends an email notifying the connection's representative that you have forwarded the record to them. Only new recipients of a record will receive a notification email.

SendOpenTasks.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
SendOpenTasks.description: Forwards open tasks related to the shared record.

StartDate.description: Date that the shared record was accepted.

Status.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Status.description: The status of the shared record. One of the following values: Active (received) Active (sent) Connected Inactive Inactive (converted) Inactive (deleted) Pending (sent)

special_access_rules: As of Winter ’21 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.
usage:
If the organization does not have Salesforce to Salesforce enabled, the PartnerNetworkRecordConnection object is not available, and you can’t access it using the API.

When you create a PartnerNetworkRecordConnection, you forward a record to a
                    connection.

Attempting to forward a record from an object to which the
                    connection is not subscribed results in an

Invalid Partner Network
                        Status

When you delete a
                PartnerNetworkRecordConnection, you stop sharing a record with a connection.
